scope: Independent full mathematical review of CCH1-CCH17 at their printed original-data scope, plus exact source-definition and inherited-consumer comparison. Formal correctness is assumed; this review concerns the human reconstruction.

per_claim_checks.assessment: Checked characteristic ell and exact constant Z_ell scalar map, full cyclotomic kernel Gprime, original polarization exponent, and full matrix span after inverting t. The residual kernel is not substituted for Gprime.

Checked every Kap field for the chosen g=0 record: the odd block is zero at a=n, generation has exponent zero and empty coefficients, independence is vacuous, and every local boundary uses the zero correction.

Checked the literal DD/eta-coordinate dictionary for TwZ, TwB and Detects, including cyclotomic twist, transpose sign, integral matrices and adic continuity. The rational trace condition is not mistaken for the endpoint.

Checked descent of the trace-zero cocycle to a derivation of the full matrix algebra, its explicit matrix-unit inner derivation, and the central residual cocycle argument using chi(g0)-1. Nondegeneracy of the trace pairing needs no division by n or n!.
Checked the transpose involution and averaging by 2, then clearing finitely many Laurent denominators. This yields the integral polarized TwB required by Detects and remains valid for n=4, ell=3.
Checked the original N3 density scope and the closed trace-zero loci modulo every t power; separation of A gives exact trace vanishing on the full original Gprime.

Checked PhiCond on the open residual-action kernel, finiteness of residual continuous cocycles, reduction kernel equal to t times the cocycle module, and the explicit coherent coefficient lifting. No unstated topological finite-generation or abstract module completeness premise is introduced.

Checked selection of finitely many original separable elements through a basis of the row span over E. Vanishing on the finite list implies the full original Detects predicate. The empty-list case is allowed.

Checked the trace-dual proof of integral-closure finiteness and freeness, locality by lifting finite-ring idempotents in the complete domain, the determinant-trick proof of a principal maximal ideal, and cofinal filtrations. Every nonzero ideal is a valuation power; the fraction field and residue field are the stated ones.

Checked the finite-field Frobenius iteration giving the unique coefficient section, the exact power-series expansion, and the finite local inclusion j(t)=v*u^e with e>=1. Constants agree with the residue embedding. An unramified parameter equality is not assumed.

Checked that one finite separable splitting extension suffices for the entire chosen list, that its roots are integral and distinct before reduction, and that the empty-list case takes the trivial extension.

Checked every original NP field and all six NP.Ext conjuncts under that same map: integral form, full block and span, inertia and ordered flags, scalar character and N1 clauses. The finite-free extension and ramification preserve the actual adic continuity.

Checked separability transport, N4 for every original subgroup via finite-free coordinates, including the separately retained old D0, and the full determinant polynomial law on every coefficient algebra. Original O-algebra and constant-field structures and the point kernel are preserved.

Checked finite-free coordinate descent of the full polarized continuous cocycle, the use of j(t)^N Aprime=u^(e*N) Aprime, and the exact unit correction v^(-a) after a common exponent is chosen. The original finite detector survives unchanged.

Checked all conjuncts of the literal h=0 Choice statement, including the one-point residue-cardinality condition. The same list, extension, point, g=0 Kap and eigenvalues are used together; no general multi-point or arbitrary-block closure is asserted.

Checked the original B2 quantifiers directly: C=0 is chosen before all m; the proof works at every N; c=(1) has a unit coefficient; zero lies in every required Sel2 clause; the final Fin(0) equality is vacuous. This is for CCH15’s same g=0 Kap only.

Checked the original same-J h=0 NiceI consumer, CIP normalization, CAP PhiCond/list realization, the unchanged old N4 and full residual determinant, the exact B1 parameter 4[Lplus:Q]+4T.q, and the coupled B2 witness. Both original Links and their fixed-iota/common-threshold order remain. Ordinary data, four Hida endpoints, same-J HasAut, B1, Raw and CohP are retained.

source_validation.method: Independent SHA256 recomputation; source bytes compared with git show at the fixed pin; every cited inclusive line range and repeated claim/source occurrence checked against the inventory.

scope_guards: Original finite coefficient field and its exact Z_ell map; ell is any odd prime, explicitly including ell=3 at rank four. No n or n! is inverted.
The full-block condition a=n is supplied by the original NiceI normalization. No NiceE or arbitrary two-block conclusion is asserted.
Gprime is the FULL cyclotomic kernel, not the residual cyclotomic kernel and not the later TWGrp.H.
The detector is the full original TwZ-to-TwB condition, with cyclotomic twist, transpose sign and adic continuity. Rational trace vanishing alone is not the endpoint.
PhiCond is used at every needed open subgroup; no topological finite-generation assumption is substituted.
One finite list is chosen before one common finite local coefficient extension; the same list survives by a finite-free coordinate argument.
The extension may be ramified: j(t)=v*u^e, e>=1. Both adic continuity and the final Detects exponent use this e.
Every original NP flag, character, form and inertia field is checked; N4 transports for every subgroup, including old D0 even if the intermediate frame stores bottom.
The complete determinant polynomial law is preserved over every coefficient algebra, as are the same O-algebra map, residue constants and point kernel.
Choice and B2 are coupled on the same chosen g=0 Kap. B2 uses C=0 before all m and actually holds for all N, including zero; no arbitrary-Kap closure.
Unchanged CohP and every original LocCFT/coefficient/level/cyclotomic side condition stay required in the original same-J consumer.
The ideal J is fixed before the point, normalization, coefficient extension, detector/list, realized T/TWPl and all N.
Both original rank-four Links remain, with common kappa and literal distinct auxiliary-prime condition; they have different original rings and need not share an ideal.
Fix iota first, then one common coefficient threshold, then every later coefficient, Space and arbitrary original B,Lambda; the pointwise extension does not change that external threshold.
closed_at_reviewed_scope: Original h=0 full-block Choice after NiceI normalization
Literal B2 for the SAME g=0 Kap chosen in that Choice
Conditional same-J support installation using these coupled outputs
not_claimed_closed: ordinary/free/control modules, full IsUniv and separating arithmetic fibers

issues_resolved.finding: The valuation argument concerns nonzero ideals; the original sentence omitted nonzero.
issues_resolved.resolution: The final proof now says all nonzero ideals are powers of the maximal ideal. The revised text and hashes were rechecked.

classical_application_assessment: No published theorem is left as a new unproved application. The needed finite complete DVR statement is proved independently; the two Stacks references are corroborating general counterparts only.

primary_references_checked.title: Lemma 10.161.8
primary_references_checked.role: Corroborates trace-dual finiteness for a finite separable extension of a Noetherian normal domain; not a premise.

primary_references_checked.title: Remark 15.113.6
primary_references_checked.role: Corroborates the DVR integral-closure setting and unique prime for a complete base; not a premise.

review_limitations: All seventeen human proofs were reviewed mathematically and the listed byte bindings independently verified. This is not a new Lean build or a claim that Count II, the remaining deep producers, general Choice, or the arbitrary-Kap obstruction theorem are complete.
